what: Kokoro-82M q8 (onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX, model_quantized.onnx) via kokoro-js 1.2.1 and transformers.js, WASM backend, headless Chromium on Centroid (16 cores, no GPU), cross-origin isolated. Second generation of a 4.9 s sentence; model fetched from Hugging Face for the spike only.
conclusion: Runs, produces audio, but below real time on CPU (0.56x with 1 thread, 0.86x with 8). Needs a real GPU adapter or is not viable as a streaming voice on CPU.
